text: With the focus of the Clan, marigold, thyme bundles, betony, oak leaf bundles, juniper bunches, wild garlic, doses of poppy seeds, moss clumps, plantain bundles, daisies, raspberry clusters, lungwort, goldenrod, tansy, elder leaf bundles, cobwebs, mallow, horsetail clumps, ragwort, dandelions, and mullein were gathered.

PurrfectClan and PhloxClan arrive at the Gathering's meeting place at the same time; Rosemaryzoom halts the Clan with a tail-signal and gestures for PhloxClan's leader to enter first. (PhloxClan relations improved.)

Nebulapaw is surprised to have been sought out specifically by PurrfectClan. He's no stranger to living in groups, but all this Code business sounds awfully complicated... Eventually, Nebulapaw comes round and accompanies the PurrfectClan cats back to camp.
Previously believed to be a natural course of events, Doecrash's death is now known for what it was: a murder at the paws of Mousefur.
Zapstar finally feels back to normal after the strain of birthing a litter.
Zapstar tries to get on patrols with Weedfleck. (medium positive effect)
Zapstar thinks that Gardeniapelt is very creative. (medium positive effect)
Rosemaryzoom always goes to Twigfrond first when she needs advice. (high positive effect)
Rosemaryzoom, Shiningshriek, and Runnelprickle took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Rosemaryzoom saw Mousefur show off a skill she never knew she had. (high positive effect)
Lakescratch is taken aback by one of Burrowkit's comments. (low negative effect)
Lakescratch and Graybreeze reminisce about happy memories together. (high positive effect)
Eggshell snaps at Honeyseeker for seeking treatment for something trivial and wasting her time. (medium negative effect)
Graybreeze respects Eggshell's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Eggshell watches Swarmspot give an elder the best piece of prey on the pile. She feels lucky to have such a kind cat as her mate.
Shiningshriek protects Zapstar from something on a patrol. (medium positive effect)
Shiningshriek is asking Pebbleswirl interesting questions. (low positive effect)
Pebbleswirl's tick fever has subsided.
Pebbleswirl asks Pipsqueak to teach her how to sing so well. (medium positive effect)
Pebbleswirl was rudely awoken by Fluffyfur. (medium negative effect)
Rosemaryzoom keeps avoiding eye contact with Pepperlion. (medium negative effect)
Pepperlion is baffled by something Bluetuft says about religion. (medium negative effect)
Whisperings on the wind tickle at Eggshell's ears as she gazes up to the stars, an echo rolling smoothly off her tongue. StarClan blesses Twilightkite and welcomes him!
Twilightkite is looking out for Silkykit's well-being. (medium positive effect)
Twilightkite is always happy to be around Nebulapaw. (high positive effect)
A cloud parts over Graybreeze and Brightdapple, shining a light on them. They interpret this as a sign that they are meant for great things soon. (high positive effect)
Graybreeze talks to one of Fogpurr's friends and begins to understand why others like him. (high positive effect)
Pipsqueak swears that Eggcrawl stole something from her nest. (high negative effect)
Pipsqueak doesn't think that Fleetrump has been completely honest lately. (low negative effect)
Wing vents about something trivial to Violetheart. (low positive effect)
Violetheart realizes how hard it is to hold a conversation with Dayheart. (medium negative effect)
Softpuddle bickers with Blazeleaf over who gets what nest material. (low negative effect)
Softpuddle defends Dayheart from a Clanmate's rude remarks. (high positive effect)
Yellowfur acts childishly in front of Dayheart. (low negative effect)
Dayheart doesn't see why Myrtlestripe is upset about something trivial. (low negative effect)
Weedfleck knows that Thornpaw fake-laughed at his joke. (medium negative effect)
Weedfleck, Brightdapple, and Dayheart took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Weedfleck decorates Phloxwhistle's nest with flowers to surprise her! (high positive effect)
Weedfleck was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Pebbleswirl last night... (high positive effect)
Weedfleck spent too long out in the sun. He's gotten heat stroke.
Badgerstreak appreciates Elkpaw telling her that she had a feather stuck to her face. (low positive effect)
Badgerstreak talks about what to do tomorrow with Fluffyfur. (medium positive effect)
Blazeleaf gazes up into Silverpelt and finds that, finally, the grief has begun to lessen.
Blazeleaf gets some good advice from Flippaw about something trivial. (low positive effect)
Blazeleaf, Sprucefreckle, and Cloudmeadow had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Cloudmeadow tells Blazeleaf that he was worried about him. (low positive effect)
Honeyseeker learns that Flurryears is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
At first, Honeyseeker wasn't certain about watching Lynxkit, Burrowkit, Rustkit, and Partridgekit. However, the kits surprise her by being on their best behavior. (positive effect)
Honeyseeker doubts whether Ratpelt even likes her at all... (high negative effect)
Honeyseeker spent too long out in the sun. She's gotten heat stroke.
Ratpelt complains about something Shiningshriek did. (low negative effect)
Ratpelt called Whistleeyes lazy, and Whistleeyes has retaliated by nitpicking everything that Ratpelt does. (high negative effect)
Ratpelt gives Twigfrond a beautiful feather they found, and hides behind their whiskers when thanked. (high positive effect)
Swarmspot has recovered from her sprain.
Swarmspot promises to always look out for Cloudmeadow. (high positive effect)
The moonlight encourages Swarmspot, Softpuddle, Bluetuft, Poppypaw, and Duckpaw to slow down and stretch. (positive effect)
Swarmspot thinks the Clan's ancestors smile upon Sprucefreckle. (high positive effect)
Gardeniapelt and Elkpaw always learn something new when they're together. (high positive effect)
Gardeniapelt, Twilightkite, and Phloxwhistle had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Minnowstripe gives Gardeniapelt something that she dropped. (low positive effect)
Sprucefreckle learns about a terrible mistake Whistleeyes made. (high negative effect)
Sprucefreckle knows Lakescratch is also interested in Swarmspot. (negative effect)
Minnowstripe soothes Sprucefreckle's irrational thoughts. (medium positive effect)
Ocelotfur has healed from her claw-wound.
Ocelotfur can't stop thinking about the strange joke Bigpaw told the other day. (medium negative effect)
Fleetrump is impressed by Softpuddle helping others today. (low positive effect)
Fleetrump warns Ocelotfur about something on the ground so she doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
Mousefur learns about a terrible mistake Pebbleswirl made. (high negative effect)
Mousefur, Rosemaryzoom, and Violetheart took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Mousefur just told Pipsqueak a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Marigoldkit tells Brightdapple that he was worried about her. (low positive effect)
The moonlight encourages Brightdapple, Dayheart, Fleetrump, Lakescratch, and Rosemaryzoom to slow down and stretch. (positive effect)
Shiningshriek gives Brightdapple the coziest piece of nest material she has. (medium positive effect)
m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.
An issue becomes benign when Myrtlestripe remembers Pebbleswirl's advice. (medium positive effect)
Myrtlestripe attempts to keep Tanglepaw, Poppypaw, Bigpaw, and Thornpaw focused during training, but the four continuously talk about unrelated topics. (negative effect)
Myrtlestripe is inspired by Fleetrump's passion. (medium positive effect)
Myrtlestripe's tail was badly hurt by a fox while he was trying to follow Zapstar's orders.
Twigfrond and Flamepaw make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
Twigfrond confesses something to Badgerstreak. (high positive effect)
Phloxwhistle explains what a joke means to Softpuddle. (low positive effect)
Phloxwhistle, Dayheart, and Zapstar had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Phloxwhistle always goes to Weedfleck first when she needs advice. (high positive effect)
Fluffyfur and Badgerstreak roll up moss balls together. (low positive effect)
Stickpaw, Rosemaryzoom, Vervainpelt, and Twigfrond respect how dutiful Fluffyfur is to training, but they all wish they weren't up doing stretches at dawn. (negative effect)
Fluffyfur thinks Yellowfur is so much braver than her. (medium positive effect)
Wing has healed from all her scrapes.
During rough weather, Honeyseeker helps Wing get safely to her den. (medium positive effect)
Robinsky laughs at bad jokes from Weedfleck. (medium positive effect)
Robinsky and Badgerstreak plan all their days together. (high positive effect)
Yellowfur can think of a hundred good things to say about Vervainpelt. (high positive effect)
Bluetuft does something that makes Yellowfur's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
Stonewhisker and Shiningshriek always challenge one another. (high positive effect)
Stonewhisker and Badgerstreak talk about what they see in the clouds. (low positive effect)
Bluetuft is proud to be in the same Clan as Lakescratch. (high positive effect)
Wing pulled an embarrassing prank on Bluetuft's friend. (low negative effect)
Jackdawblur's sprain has healed.
Jackdawblur had a good dream about Lynxkit. (low positive effect)
When Jackdawblur asked Hickoryhope for help, Hickoryhope ignored her. (low negative effect)
Whenever someone asks whether Whistleeyes will be alright raising her single kitten alone, she just smiles and replies that everything is going to work out fine.
Whistleeyes swears that Zapstar stole something from her nest. (high negative effect)
Whistleeyes, Cloudmeadow, and Swarmspot took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Whistleeyes left a gift in Ratpelt's nest for them to find. (medium positive effect)
Cloudmeadow and Hickoryhope make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
A cloud parts over Cloudmeadow and Twilightkite, shining a light on them. They interpret this as a sign that they are meant for great things soon. (high positive effect)
Hickoryhope and Stonewhisker defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Hickoryhope wants this training exercise to be a success, but Thornpaw, Mosspaw, Tanglepaw, and Elkpaw refuse to listen, and Hickoryhope gives up. (negative effect)
Flurryears's small cut is no longer bothering him.
Flurryears offers to groom a hard-to-reach place for Cloudmeadow, who thanks him earnestly. (high positive effect)
Flurryears appreciates Myrtlestripe, Ratpelt, Bigpaw, and Rosemaryzoom joining him to stretch late into the night so he wouldn't be alone. (positive effect)
Flurryears had a dream about Twilightkite. (low positive effect)
Shadowwind's broken bone has healed.
Silkykit won't tell Shadowwind what she finds so funny. (medium negative effect)
Shadowwind warns Hickoryhope about something on the ground so she doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
Runnelprickle's small cut has healed up nicely.
Runnelprickle learns something new about a Clanmate from Poppypaw. (low positive effect)
Blazeleaf makes a small sacrifice that benefits Runnelprickle. (low positive effect)
Squirreltail reassures Whistleeyes about something that was bothering her. (low positive effect)
Squirreltail, Twilightkite, and Elkpaw took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Mosspaw tries to dig into one of Squirreltail's secrets. (medium negative effect)
PurrfectClan welcomes Elkbeak as a new warrior, honoring his friendliness.
Mosspaw respects Elkbeak's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Early in the morning, Elkbeak rallies Flamepaw, Stickpaw, Duckpaw, and Tanglepaw to do stretches in hopes of keeping his Clanmates prepared for anything. (negative effect)
Jackdawblur's laugh reminds Elkbeak of someone he misses. (low positive effect)
Duckpaw talks with Dayheart about some Clan drama. (low positive effect)
Squirreltail tells Duckpaw that her pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Bigpaw mews congratulations to Twilightkite for a job well done. (low positive effect)
Flurryears lets Bigpaw grab a piece of fresh-kill first. (low positive effect)
Duckpaw tells Flippaw that she was worried about her. (low positive effect)
Flippaw learns that Squirreltail is scared of thunder, too. (low positive effect)
Mosspaw has recovered from his mangled tail.
Mosspaw just told Yarrowkit a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Tanglepaw uses one of Mosspaw's fears against him. (high negative effect)
Flamepaw learns something new about a Clanmate from Elkbeak. (low positive effect)
Thornpaw lets Flamepaw know that a Clanmate was talking badly about him. (low positive effect)
Stickpaw is grateful that Ratpelt has kept a secret of hers. (medium positive effect)
Stickpaw doesn't think it's usually this easy to convince Ferretkit, Lynxkit, Stumpkit, and Partridgekit to settle down, but it is today. (positive effect)
Stickpaw can't help but smile seeing Mosspaw smile. (low positive effect)
Both Tanglepaw and Marigoldkit avoid one another's eye contact. (low negative effect)
Thornpaw managed to recover from his heat exhaustion.
Silkykit asks Thornpaw to show her how to do a hunter's crouch, and he obliges, happy to show his skills. (medium positive effect)
Thornpaw noticed that Poppypaw is falling behind in training and offered to help him catch up. (medium positive effect)
Poppypaw is giving Partridgekit a badger ride on his back! (medium positive effect)
Thunderwing thinks Burrowkit looks nicer than him today. (low negative effect)
Thunderwing can't help but smile seeing Eggshell smile. (low positive effect)
Fogpurr noticed Marigoldkit is doing his best today. (low positive effect)
Fogpurr learns some pelt-grooming techniques from Lakescratch, and tells Lakescratch some of his own. (low positive effect)
Eggcrawl had a terrible dream about Vervainpelt. (medium negative effect)
Minnowstripe saw Silkykit hide something before talking to her. (low negative effect)
Minnowstripe feels like she can count on Lakescratch to give her the best treatment possible. (medium positive effect)
Vervainpelt feels bad that she caused a problem for Minnowstripe. (medium positive effect)
Vervainpelt, Badgerstreak, and Swarmspot had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Pipsqueak vents about something trivial to Vervainpelt. (low positive effect)
Marigoldkit decorates Partridgekit's nest with flowers to surprise her! (high positive effect)
Marigoldkit bristles after being scolded by Burrowkit. (high negative effect)
Burrowkit believes everything Pebbleswirl says. (medium positive effect)
Burrowkit doesn't want to do anything without Marigoldkit. (high positive effect)
Ferretkit feels safe with Fleetrump around. (high positive effect)
Ferretkit and Marigoldkit hunt moss balls and sticks for the fresh-kill pile. (medium positive effect)
Rustkit isn't afraid to ask Twigfrond a difficult question. (high positive effect)
Yarrowkit and Sprucefreckle can't seem to agree on the truth about something. (medium negative effect)
Yarrowkit and Rustkit only ever want to play with each other. (high positive effect)
Silkykit works extra hard after seeing how skilled Dayheart is. (low positive effect)
Silkykit brushes against Rustkit while correcting his stance and looks away with a purr. (medium positive effect)
Lynxkit finds a bit of fluff that smells like Shiningshriek and adds it to her nest. (low positive effect)
Lynxkit can tell how brave Silkykit is being about something important. (low positive effect)
Fluffyfur respects Stumpkit's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Lynxkit asks Stumpkit to stop following her around. (medium negative effect)
Partridgekit didn't know that Blazeleaf was so talented. (medium positive effect)
Nebulapaw and Stickpaw have a long discussion about goals and aspirations, and find that they don't agree on many things. (high negative effect)
